visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man wearing a black baseball cap with a colorful logo and a grey athletic hoodie stands in a brightly lit indoor baseball stadium. He is smiling warmly while talking to someone off-camera, holding a bright red baseball glove in his left hand against his chest. Behind him, the green turf of the stadium is visible along with some training equipment and distant figures. (2) The scene shifts to the man on the baseball field during an event, now wearing a professional white and blue baseball uniform with the number 71 on his back. He winds up and throws a baseball with a focused expression. The camera follows the ball's trajectory as it flies towards a target screen featuring a cartoon character and numbered zones. (3) The man hits the target successfully, and he immediately raises his arms in celebration. A person in a grey hoodie runs into the frame excitedly, and other teammates in uniform rush toward him to exchange high-fives and celebrate the successful throw in the middle of the field.
